results.evidence: Heartbeat watchdog, disconnect, reconnect and recovery gates

results.expected: Reject integration evidence not bound to the persisted commit-vector digest
results.evidence: Exact SHAs were present but the immutable vector artifact digest was omitted
results.deficiency: Integration evidence was not bound to the persisted commit-vector artifact
results.correction: Require the exact commit_vector_digest in integration evidence and gates

results.stages: sequence gap -> snapshot recovery -> integration -> PR gate
results.expected: Recovered order book converges and reaches PR_APPROVED
results.evidence: Snapshot completeness, sender change and stale-message gates

results.expected: Verify detects changed repository evidence after it was accepted
results.evidence: Accepted gate result was changed from PASS to FAIL on disk
results.deficiency: Run verification did not re-hash repository evidence
results.correction: Persist evidence paths and verify every stored evidence digest

results.repositories: contracts, ETI gateway and all market-data consumers
results.expected: Reject a migration PASS gate without requirement IDs and source references
results.evidence: Gate had exact commit-vector binding but no normative source linkage
results.deficiency: Integration PASS gates could be untraceable to authoritative specifications
results.correction: Require requirement_ids and source_refs on every integration gate

results.expected: Reject BLOCKED_SPEC evidence that does not explain the normative blocker
results.evidence: EDCI includes lean orders but provides no history from before connection
results.deficiency: BLOCKED_SPEC could be recorded without an accountable reason
results.correction: Require a non-empty reason for BLOCKED_SPEC

results.repositories: matching engine, pre-trade risk and downstream lifecycle
results.stages: implementation -> business invariants -> integration -> PR gate
results.expected: SMP boundary and synthetic exception reach PR_APPROVED
results.evidence: Same-owner, auction and synthetic cross-instrument behavior

results.repositories: gateway, matcher and all downstream trade consumers
results.stages: failure -> bounded remediation -> recovery integration -> PR gate
results.evidence: Persistent restore, transient purge and ordered reconnect gates

results.repositories: gateway, market data, operations and affected consumers
results.stages: DR topology -> isolation -> reconnect -> PR gate
results.expected: DR single-stream and environment-fencing flow reaches PR_APPROVED
results.evidence: DR endpoints, absent EOBI Stream B, data fence and reconnect gates

results.expected: Reject requester identity even when reviewer casing differs
results.deficiency: PR reviewer separation-of-duties comparison was case-sensitive
results.correction: Compare requester and every reviewer using casefolded identities
